Corollary
[Mean value strong maximum principle] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0210 ↗ cor:euclidean-heat-mean-value-property 1. ch12:12.46\group Strong Scalar Maximum Principles

If a heat solution on a connected cylinder attains its supremum at an interior point $(x_1,t_1)$, it equals that supremum at all $(y,s)$ with $s\leq t_1$. The analogous statement holds for an attained infimum.

Proof

\sketch The kernel in Corollary 4.1 is nonnegative and has total mass one. Equality of its weighted average with an attained maximum forces equality throughout every contained heat ball. Overlapping heat balls and connectedness propagate the equality to every earlier point. Apply the same argument to $-u$ for minima.

□
